Updated `src/utils.js` to keep Fractal’s existing language metadata contract compatible with `@allmarkedup/fang` v2.

The change normalizes v2’s `ace_mode`/`tm_scope` fields back to `{ name, mode, scope, color }` and preserves the existing Markdown/Nunjucks classifications where v2 would otherwise change behavior.
